doc: J8a without the desktop: a bash command with a side effect (`echo ran-<tag> >> side-effects.log; sleep 30`), SIGKILL the kernel during the sleep, restart it. The continued turn must not run the command again — side-effects.log holds the tag once (qal-j02 / #316).

breaks.detail: side-effects.log holds the tag 2 time(s) across the kernel restart (expected once; qal-j02)
